description: One trader's record by ref: profit, win rate, return, record by kind of market, and consistency (profitable weeks, best week's share of profit, largest drawdown, profit over drawdown, trades a day). include adds sections, each costing one more request: positions (open and recent positions), curve (profit over time), habits (when and how they bet), similar (traders like them). Each different trader opened counts toward the account's 100 traders a day; opening the same one again that day is free.
name: get_trader
title: One trader
